title: Clawback of Instant Return Store Credit after Inspection — Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
Return Store Credit issued before a return was inspected is clawed back, once the return's inspection results are posted, for the instant-credit recovery (reason: failed return inspection), booked against the return's number with no order number. The clawback is the recovery entry on the Gift Cards & Store Credit ledger of that store credit: it is tagged with the return's number and lowers the store credit's current balance by the instant-credit recovery owed on that return.

## Business effect

| Before | After the clawback is booked |
|---|---|
| The return's inspection results are posted; the store credit still holds the instant credit loaded at issue | A clawback entry for the instant-credit recovery, tagged with the return's number and the reason failed return inspection, appears in the store credit's balance history, and the new balance shows on the store credit |
| | A store credit whose balance reaches 0.00 shows as depleted |

## Action: `claw_back_instrument_value_f010c427`

**Capability.** Takes value back from one of the customer's stored-value instruments (a Return Store Credit or a Bonus Gift Card) because the event that justified that value has been undone. One call books a single clawback entry on the instrument for the amount given, tagged with its reason and with the return number or order number that caused it, and lowers the instrument's current balance by that amount; an instrument whose balance reaches 0.00 is shown as depleted.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side action: unlock `claw_back_instrument_value_f010c427`, then call it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `instrument_id` | The reference number of the stored-value instrument the value is taken from, as shown by the stored-value instrument lookup for this customer | Id |
| `clawback_reason` | Why the value is taken back | Exactly one of: `failed_return_inspection` (the inspected return behind an instant Return Store Credit is owed less than the instant credit that was loaded); `qualifying_purchase_refunded` (the gift-card purchase that earned a Bonus Gift Card has been cancelled or refunded); `not_applicable` (describes only balance entries that are not clawbacks, and is never the reason of a clawback booked with this action) |
| `return_id` | The return (RMA) number whose inspection caused the clawback, as shown by the return lookup | Id; an empty value "" when the clawback is caused by a refunded gift-card purchase |
| `order_id` | The order number whose refunded gift-card purchase caused the clawback, as shown by the order lookup | Id; an empty value "" when the clawback is caused by a return inspection |
| `clawback_usd` | The value taken back | A positive amount in USD with 2 decimal places (for example 12.40); it is booked as a negative entry of the same size |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new clawback entry reference, the instrument reference, the reason, the amount taken back in USD with 2 decimal places, and the instrument's new balance in USD with 2 decimal places with its status (active, or depleted at 0.00). The presence of the entry reference means the clawback was booked.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with a Return Store Credit's reference, reason `failed_return_inspection`, the return's number, an empty order number and 21.30 books a clawback entry of 21.30 against that return; a credit that held 50.00 then shows a balance of 28.70, status active.
